caption: The drawing features a single transparent beer mug rendered in light brown or amber tones, positioned centrally against a plain beige background. The mug is cylindrical and tapers slightly from top to bottom. The handle, attached near the top and bottom of the right side, is rounded and has a gentle curve with a decorative, knotted detail at the top attachment point. Subtle shading and highlights suggest the form and transparency of the mug, with visible reflections, glass thickness at the rim, and the circular base. There are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Mug
